title: 第5章 敕封庙祝神只显灵震惊村民第6章 成庙祝返老还童信仰暴涨
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
很快。
李有鸣就带着两个儿子来到了土地庙。
土地庙建在村子的北边，一个小土坡上。
土地庙的左侧，还有一株很有年头的老柳树，垂落下大量柳枝。
“德生、德明，你们赶紧把棚子搭起来。”
李有鸣大手一挥，指挥道。
有儿子在，这种事情哪里用得着他老人家去做？
“爹，你真要成为土地庙的庙祝？”
李德生苦着脸道。
他长得相当健硕，高了李有鸣一个头，看起来魁梧有力。
但练武资质却很差，今年二十八岁，练了十几年‘裂石掌’，可却依旧没有能够让气血蜕变一次，迈入‘炼体境’成为武者。
“那还有假？”
“彰越公托梦，你爹以后就是彰越公在人间的代表！”
李有鸣斜视了一眼长子，佝偻的背都挺直了不少。
李德生和李德明兄弟俩对视一眼。
都能看到对方眼中的无奈。
什么彰越公托梦，他们是半点不信。
觉得多半是自己老子做了个这样的梦。
不过两兄弟都对自家老子相当敬畏，也不敢反驳。
反正自家老子怎么说，他们就怎么做呗。

没有过多废话，两兄弟开始了搭棚，也就是捡些木头搭起来，对他们来说不难。
这时候。
一些村子里的老人也听到了消息，立即赶了过来。
“有鸣，彰越公真给你托梦了？”
李有堂拄着拐杖，颤颤巍巍的，瞪大眼睛道。
他的年纪比李有鸣要大五六岁，整个李家村他是最年长之人。
“有鸣，真的假的？”
“彰越公真让你成为庙祝？”
“德阳跟我们说，你还要代表彰越公行走人间？”
“难不成昨日的壮身草，真是彰越公享用了？”
“有平，壮身草肯定是彰越公享用了啊，你还不信？”
七八名老人站在土地庙前，你一言我一语的，好几人都显得颇为激动。
李有鸣用力挺直着佝偻的背，向这些老兄弟得意道：
“我李有鸣是什么样的人大家伙都清楚。”
“昨晚彰越公确确实实给我托梦了，让我代替祂行走人间。”
“从此之后，你们别再有鸣有鸣的叫了，要称呼我为庙祝！”
更远一些。
村长李德阳面色古怪。
他认认真真的看着李有鸣的表情，觉得有些不像演的。
不过彰越公托梦绝对不可能。

应该是有鸣叔自己梦到了彰越公而已。
他的看法和李德生兄弟一样。
content_en:
soon.
Li Youming took his two sons to the Tutu Temple.
The Earth Temple is built on a small earth slope in the north of the village.
On the left side of the Tutu Temple, there is an old willow tree with a large number of willow branches hanging down.
"Desheng, Deming, hurry up and put up the shed."
Li Youming waved his hand and commanded.
With his son here, why would he need to do such a thing?
"Dad, do you really want to become the temple blessing of the Earth Temple?"
Li Desheng said with a grimace.
He was quite muscular, a head taller than Li Youming, and looked burly and powerful.
However, his qualifications for martial arts training are very poor. He is twenty-eight years old this year and has practiced the 'Splitter Palm' for more than ten years, but he still has not been able to transform his energy and blood and enter the 'Physical Refining Realm' to become a warrior.
"Then there is still a holiday?"
"Mr. Zhang Yue has entrusted me with a dream. From now on, your father will be Mr. Zhang Yue's representative in the world!"
Li Youming glanced sideways at his eldest son, his rickety back straightened a lot.
Brothers Li Desheng and Li Deming looked at each other.
You can all see the helplessness in the other person's eyes.
They didn't believe it at all.
I think it was probably me who had such a dream.
However, both brothers were in awe of their father and did not dare to refute.
Anyway, whatever my father says, they will do it.
Without too much nonsense, the two brothers started to build the tent, which was to pick up some wood and build it. It was not difficult for them.
This time.
Some elderly people in the village also heard the news and rushed over immediately.
"Youming, did Mr. Zhang Yue really entrust you with a dream?"
Li Youtang leaned on crutches, trembling, and said with wide eyes.
He is five or six years older than Li Youming, and he is the oldest person in the entire Lijia Village.
"Youming, is it true or false?"
"Did Lord Zhang Yue really want you to become the temple's blessing?"
"Deyang told us that you still want to walk the earth on behalf of your righteousness?"
"Is it possible that yesterday's body-building grass was really enjoyed by Duke Zhang Yue?"
"Youping, the body-strengthening grass must have been enjoyed by Duke Zhang Yue. You still don't believe it?"
Seven or eight old people stood in front of the Tutu Temple, talking to each other, and several of them seemed quite excited.
Li Youming straightened his rickety back and said proudly to these old brothers:
"Everyone knows what kind of person I, Li Youming, am."
"Last night Duke Zhang Yue indeed gave me a dream, asking me to walk the world in his stead."
"From now on, you should stop calling me Ming Ming and call me Miao Zhu!"
Further away.
Village chief Li Deyang looked strange.
He looked at Li Youming's expression seriously and felt that something was not acting.
However, it is absolutely impossible for Zhang Yue to entrust his dream.
It should be that Uncle Youming dreamed of Duke Zhang Yue.
His views are the same as those of the Li Desheng brothers.
